import time, sys
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

URL = "http://localhost:8934/index.html"

def log(*a):
    print(*a, flush=True)

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 1400})
    errors = []
    page.on("pageerror", lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
    page.on("console", lambda m: log("[console]", m.type, m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)
    page.goto(URL)
    page.wait_for_selector("text=Kick Off", timeout=15000)

    # Select Ultra Mode format
    page.click("button:has-text('Ultra Mode')")
    page.screenshot(path="/tmp/ss_00_setup.png")

    # Confirm the toggle is 'on'
    ultra_on = page.eval_on_selector_all("button", """
        (btns) => btns.filter(b => b.textContent.includes('Ultra Mode')).map(b => b.className)
    """)
    log("Ultra button classes:", ultra_on)

    page.click("button:has-text('Kick Off')")

    # Draft loop: repeatedly pick an eligible candidate, then a highlighted slot if needed
    for i in range(30):
        page.wait_for_timeout(300)
        # wait until at least one eligible candidate is present (spin settles)
        try:
            page.wait_for_selector(".fd-cand.elig", timeout=8000)
        except Exception:
            # maybe draft already complete -> teamsheet
            break
        cands = page.query_selector_all(".fd-cand.elig")
        if not cands:
            break
        cands[0].click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(150)
        # if a slot-picking UI appeared, click first highlighted empty slot
        hl_slots = page.query_selector_all(".fd-slot.empty.hl")
        if hl_slots:
            hl_slots[0].click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(150)
        # check if we reached teamsheet phase
        if page.query_selector("text=Run the simulation"):
            log(f"Draft complete after ~{i+1} picks")
            break

    page.screenshot(path="/tmp/ss_01_teamsheet.png")

    # Run the simulation
    page.click("button:has-text('Run the simulation')")
    page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    page.screenshot(path="/tmp/ss_02_live_start.png")

    # Step through live matches by clicking "Skip game" repeatedly, capturing state
    match_count_seen = 0
    for i in range(40):
        page.wait_for_timeout(200)
        skip = page.query_selector("button:has-text('Skip game')")
        cont = page.query_selector(".fd-continue")
        if skip:
            skip.click()
            match_count_seen += 1
            page.wait_for_timeout(150)
        elif cont:
            cont.click()
            page.wait_for_timeout(200)
        else:
            # maybe done or a gate (table/bracket/shootout) with a button
            btn = page.query_selector(".fd-gate button, .fd-btn")
            if btn and btn.is_visible():
                btn.click()
                page.wait_for_timeout(200)
            else:
                break
        if i % 5 == 0:
            page.screenshot(path=f"/tmp/ss_live_{i:02d}.png")

    page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    page.screenshot(path="/tmp/ss_03_final.png")

    body_text = page.inner_text("body")
    log("---- FINAL PAGE TEXT (truncated) ----")
    log(body_text[:3000])

    log("JS errors:", errors)
    browser.close()

I reviewed the engine code (`createRun`, used by the live/interactive screen) and drove the actual app in a headless browser through two full Ultra Mode games, start to finish:

- Setup screen: "Ultra Mode" toggle selects `format: 'ultra'`.
- Live match view: the mode badge correctly reads "ULTRA · 20-0" throughout drafting and simulation.
- League phase plays out all 13 games (not 8 or 6) before the standings gate, with cutoffs already scaled for Ultra (26/16 pts instead of 16/10).
- Knockout progression (play-off → R16 → QF → SF → Final) and shootouts work identically for Ultra, since only the league-phase length differs.
- The final verdict correctly read "FINAL VERDICT · 20-MATCH EUROPEAN RUN" in both test runs, with `played` counts matching the actual games simulated (17, having gone out in the Round of 16 after 13 league + 2 playoff + 2 R16 games).

This all traces back to the prior "Add Ultra Mode" commit, which already threaded `isUltra`/`targetN` through both the engine (`createRun`) and the shared UI (`modeBadges`, `targetN2`, `matches` array) that the live match screen renders from — nothing in that screen hardcodes game counts for the old formats. So the live match presentation already correctly reflects Ultra Mode's 20-game run; no code changes were needed. I cleaned up the temporary Playwright driver scripts and local server used for testing.
